title: Characteristics and Outcome of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) in Egypt
brief_summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has recently declared coronavirus disease 2019 (Covid-19) a public health emergency of international concern. Egypt is one of the countries that has been infected by Covid-19. The characteristics of clinical presentation, laboratory and radiological data are not yet studied. Outcomes of covid-19 in Egypt also have not been described yet.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with diagnosis of Covid-19 .

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients refuse to participate in the study
study_population: Patients with clinical presentation and confirmed as Covid-19 according to the definition of Egyptian Ministry of Health.
